contract: Awake IL_003e–IL_004a copies keyName.text to defaultLabelText; IsShiftKey compares303/304.
Generate parses layout, matches specialKeys by keycode, passes name to Assign atIL_0313–032a, binds existing callbacks or KeyCall, preserves doneKey; final Shift broadcasts remain exact.
Special-key lookup compares keycode, not caption spelling.
KeyCall focus/dictionary guards; key13 Submit, Shift303/304 case toggle, printable keycode->char/ToUpper; KeySpace emits ASCII space; OnPhysicalKeyStroke uses existing char-to-keycode map.
Click preserves isPressed guard and OnMouseDown/OnMouseUp timing; button state unchanged.
Assign writes key, label from explicit name or char(key), then keyType; does not derive keycode from translated label.
Relabel applies only to Shift303/304 or302 and uses defaultLabelText on null; it does not restore Return/Done.
Plant UI Awake binds instructions/button-hint animators and timer/dash labels; observed label family preserved. Dynamic animator states and gameplay not altered.
